components.name: Bypass Diodes

components.name: Insulating Foams

components.name: Anti-Passivation Coating

components.name: Ground Fault Detection and Isolation (GFDI) System
components.reasoning: Optional safety feature integrated into advanced modules for detecting ground faults and protecting wiring, not always required or standard.

components.name: Solar Cells (Monocrystalline Silicon)
components.reasoning: These are the essential photovoltaic elements that convert light into electricity and form the core function of any PV module.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: The glass cover protects the solar cells from environmental factors and physical damage, making it a distinct and universally separate component in most PV module designs.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: This structural element supports the entire module, ensures correct alignment during installation, and contributes to overall durability. It is typically purchased as a complete unit.

components.name: Backsheet Material (TPT or ETFE)
components.reasoning: The backsheet provides protection from moisture and mechanical stress while facilitating the efficient transfer of heat away from the module cells. Its separation is crucial for easy maintenance and replacement in some designs.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: This component houses key electrical connections, fuses, and bypass diodes necessary for safe operation and power optimization, making it an essential distinct subassembly.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA)
components.reasoning: EVA encapsulates the cells between the glass cover and backsheet to protect against moisture ingress and maintain structural integrity, despite some alternatives like POE being used.

components.name: Adhesive Sealing Tape
components.reasoning: While not a major component itself, this material ensures that all encapsulating layers adhere properly, securing critical interfaces but often integrated within the backsheet assembly rather than purchased separately.

components.name: Polystyrene Spacers
components.reasoning: These small spacers maintain consistent spacing between layers during manufacturing and installation, ensuring optimal performance but sometimes incorporated as part of other assemblies.
